notes: Canonical model facts for the gdp, paper-refine and paper-refine-eval checkouts.
The canonical file lives in repos/common/model_catalog.json; each checkout carries an identical copy.
context_window is the window the deployment enforces (not necessarily the advertised one); max_tokens is the per-response output cap, which must leave room for the prompt.

max_tokens is the per-response cap for a harnessed agent and chat_max_tokens is the cap for one direct completion. Both assume the model always reasons: the reasoning trace counts toward the completion, so chat_max_tokens covers reasoning plus the answer. Reasoning effort is a per-run policy and is not stored here.
Every model carries verified_at (the date the numbers were re-checked) and source (where each number comes from); update both with the numbers.

models.name: deepseek-flash
source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing — official model table: id deepseek-flash, CONTEXT LENGTH 1M, MAX OUTPUT 384K.

models.name: qwen38-27b
source: https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/qwen3-8-27b — public model qwen3.8-27b: context window 1,000,000, max output 131,072.
Local deployment: the server reports a 150,000-token window (paper-refine-eval/README.md); the catalog records the deployed window because every harness talks to that server.
models.notes: max_tokens 32,768 (harness) and chat_max_tokens 80,000 (single completion) are harness policies inside the deployed 150,000-token window; the public model allows 131,072 output tokens.

models.name: dots3-note-preview
source: https://dots.ai/platform/docs — platform documentation; the page is JavaScript-only, so the advertised 512K window is taken from the operator's notes in these repos rather than read here.

Enforced ceiling measured 2026-11-10: three gdp runs were rejected with HTTP 400 once prompt + max_tokens crossed 393,000 (traceIds 2f68..., ad38..., 43385...); the DSH headless profile declares contextWindow: 393000.
models.notes: 512K is advertised, 393,000 is enforced; max_tokens 65,536 and chat_max_tokens 160,000 are harness policies.
